mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, comment_id AS commentId, level, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime, is_deleted AS isDeleted FROM user_comment_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND comment_id = #{commentId} AND level = #{level} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_comment_like(user_id, comment_id, level, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) VALUES(#{userId}, #{commentId}, #{level}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
